title: Sessions with clear conditions
description: Select exercises by equipment and movements, and keep the limitations agreed with a specialist.

blocks.text: A request for standing-only sessions is more specific than a general “for beginners” category. In the review that follows, the user explains which supports and movements don’t suit them.

quote.text: Ability to choose only standing workouts. I have a bad knee and wrist so I cannot do anything like a knee/ regular push up as it puts too much pressure on my wrist and knee.

blocks.text: Show what a session actually requires

State the body positions, the equipment and the transitions before viewing. Allow the chosen exclusions to be saved, so that unsuitable options don’t come back into the selection. Keep a swap prescribed by a specialist as an explicit change.
A filter is not a clearance

A description helps you understand the content and rule out a format that is obviously wrong. It does not confirm that an exercise is suitable with pain or limitations; the app should not draw that conclusion from a single mark in a questionnaire.
